fact_assessments.expected: Yes; to use that Powerstorm Repeat, pay the repeated Power Card's Energy cost again, in addition to the original play payment.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: May the two players interleave Gather and Damage?

contextual_extra_observations: Which player chooses to go first is not separately requested; the A-then-B order is an illustration of legal sequential resolution.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: Cleanup or outcome check first?

fact_assessments.expected: Correct the illegal position after the completed action tree but before checking victory/defeat; check the cleaned-up state.

observed.answer_text: Correct the illegal placement before checking victory or defeat. Cleanup happens before the outcome check and is not a Move or other action; it triggers nothing.

requested_part_assessment.actual_requested_clause: When the Fast threshold is applied
